capabilities: Edit resume entries in a structured form with drag-to-reorder and hideable modules
Preview the resume layout live beside the form
Override theme color, font size, spacing and avatar styling per resume
Export resumes to PDF, HTML, DOCX and LaTeX
disambiguation: Not a tool for resuming interrupted work; it edits CV/résumé documents.
extras: Installation is recommended through BRAT as a beta plugin; manual install requires copying main.js, manifest.json and styles.css into the plugin folder. Legacy .md resumes marked with frontmatter are migrated to the .resume format on save.
problem: Writing a formatted, paginated resume as a plain Markdown note means doing layout by hand, with no structured form, page preview, or export pipeline.

relations.evidence: Install the BRAT plugin from the Obsidian community plugin store.

summary: Form-driven resume editor with live preview, 12 switchable templates, per-resume styling, and PDF, HTML, DOCX and LaTeX export.
